title: Production certified release-cut registration and lifecycle governance repair

phases.objective: Restore workflow registration at runner runtime while making the validation surface branch-independent and read-only.

e2e_journeys.actor: GitHub Actions workflow registrar and certified release validator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A trusted same-repository pull request uses the governed certified-release title selector.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The workflow registers jobs, resolves evidence paths at runner runtime, validates dynamic head/base refs, and publishes artifacts without repository writes.
steps: Select the evidence-only validation surface by governed pull-request title rather than branch literals.
Validate the same-repository event and dynamic immutable head/base SHAs.
Allocate the finalize runner and export evidence paths through GITHUB_ENV from RUNNER_TEMP.
Run direct ARM validation and upload immutable evidence without comments or repository mutation.
assertions: No finalize job-level environment value references runner context.
Both evidence paths are initialized in a runtime step.
No work-branch name is embedded in the permanent workflow.
The pull_request_target workflow has read-only permissions and contains no PR comment mutation.
The direct ARM validation and immutable ancestry contracts remain enforced.
No deployment, migration, provider call, credential payload read, or Production mutation is introduced.

phases.objective: Observe branch-independent registration and exact-head evidence publication across Draft and Ready validation cycles.
Keep registration fail-closed without reintroducing write permissions, branch literals, or job-level runner context.
Prove a bounded same-repository validation cycle on the repaired read-only workflow.
Use the repaired validator only through the governed certified-release evidence path.
